$comment: Policy for scripts/quality/audit_maintainability.py (v2.4.0 T0.5). Lexical debt metrics for gate G5. Counts are candidates, not verdicts: every metric names the files it found so T6.4-T6.8 can assign path-disjoint tranches. Paths are relative to the repository root.

exclude_path_fragments./FormFiles/: Qt Designer generated forms (uic input); not hand-maintained C++.
exclude_path_fragments._autogen/: moc/uic/rcc output; generated at build time.

suppressions.$comment: Map metric -> { 'path': 'reason' }. A suppression hides one file from one metric and must say why.

The Qt message handler itself: the one place that writes log records to stdout/stderr.

ceilings.$comment: Per-metric upper bound enforced in CI (audit_maintainability.py --ceilings). Lower a ceiling in the same commit that retires debt; it may never rise. 0 means the construct is gone for good.
